howto.what: Claude 会帮你为应用添加结构化日志记录，包括设置日志级别、添加上下文和聚合日志到集中平台，方便调试和监控。
howto.when: 当你要调试应用、创建审计追踪或分析性能时，Claude 会协助设置日志系统。

say.text: 帮我在Node.js项目中配置Winston日志系统。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you implement structured logging in your applications, including setting log levels, adding context, and aggregating logs to a central platform for debugging and monitoring.
howto.when_en: When you need to debug an application, create audit trails, or analyze performance, Claude assists in setting up the logging system.

say_en.text: Help me configure Winston logging in my Node.js project.
